unit_configs.cmd:
SCRIPT_PATH=/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts

export PYTHONHASHSEED=1234
export log_level_proxy=info
export core_num=4
export start_core_index=16
export pd_policy=sequential
export max_num_batched_tokens=100000

TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/proxy.sh" \
  --omni-proxy-model-path "${MODEL_PATH}" \
  --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 100000 \
  --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 8 \
  --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 8 &&

export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=2
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1000
export gpu_util=0.88
export max_num_seqs=24
export max_num_batched_tokens=16384
export OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH="low_latency/openpangu_v2/pangu_v2_moe_bf16_a3_xp1d_p.json"
export kv_transfer_config='{"kv_buffer_device":"npu","kv_connector":"LLMDataDistConnector","kv_parallel_size":1,"kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_rank":0}'

bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/prefill.sh" \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-enable-chunked-prefill \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true,"enable_pd_elastic_scaling":true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \
  --enforce-eager && sleep infinity
unit_configs.name: prefill-0

unit_configs.cmd:
SCRIPT_PATH=/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts

export NUM_SERVERS=8
export LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE=8
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1000
export gpu_util=0.9
export max_num_seqs=24
export ENABLE_DP_LB=false
export TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1
export VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="./graph_cache"
export OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH="low_latency/openpangu_v2/pangu_v2_moe_bf16_a3_xp1d_d.json"
export kv_transfer_config='{"kv_buffer_device":"npu","kv_connector":"LLMDataDistConnector","kv_parallel_size":1,"kv_role":"kv_consumer"}'

rm -rf graph_cache/

python3 -c "import os; from transformers import AutoConfig; AutoConfig.from_pretrained(os.environ['MODEL_PATH'], trust_remote_code=True)"

bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/decode.sh" \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-enable-chunked-prefill \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --compilation-config '{"mode":3,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[96],"backend":"","compile_sizes":[96]}' \
  --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true,"enable_pd_elastic_scaling":true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' && sleep infinity
unit_configs.name: decode
